mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS id, r.refund_no AS refund_no, r.order_id AS order_id, r.type AS type, r.status AS status, r.amount AS amount, r.reason AS reason, r.remark AS remark, r.tracking_no AS tracking_no, r.applied_at AS applied_at, r.audited_at AS audited_at, r.shipped_at AS shipped_at, r.received_at AS received_at, r.refunded_at AS refunded_at, r.created_at AS created_at FROM refunds r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT r.id AS id, r.refund_no AS refund_no, r.order_id AS order_id, r.type AS type, r.status AS status, r.amount AS amount, r.reason AS reason, r.remark AS remark, r.tracking_no AS tracking_no, r.applied_at AS applied_at, r.audited_at AS audited_at, r.shipped_at AS shipped_at, r.received_at AS received_at, r.refunded_at AS refunded_at, r.created_at AS created_at FROM refunds r WHERE r.id = #{refundId} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT count(*) FROM refunds WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('APPLIED', 'APPROVED', 'RETURNING', 'REFUNDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE refunds SET status = 'APPROVED', remark = #{remark}, audited_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{refundId} AND status = 'APPLIED'
UPDATE refunds SET status = 'REJECTED', remark = #{remark}, audited_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{refundId} AND status = 'APPLIED'

UPDATE refunds SET status = 'RETURNING', tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, shipped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{refundId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND type = 'RETURN_REFUND'
UPDATE refunds SET status = 'REFUNDING', received_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{refundId} AND status = 'RETURNING'

UPDATE refunds SET status = 'SUCCESS', refunded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{refundId} AND ((status = 'APPROVED' AND type = 'REFUND_ONLY') OR status = 'REFUNDING')
